messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] hosted-api: request-queue depth spike >10k in us-west-2. p95 request latency 2.3s -> 800ms after initial mitigation, p99 12.7s. paging @sre-oncall. runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/queue-backlog

jessica: Oncall here — joining. what's the hit pattern? any known deploys?

tom: No deploys in the last 30m. infra metrics show provisioner errors: POST /provision -> 503 (rate-limited by cloud API). autoscaler requests are queuing.

maria: GPU pool us-west-2 saturated. Largest contributor looks like a sudden spike from tenant "ad-campaign-proxy" sending many short streaming requests. Many are low-priority batch jobs kept open.

derek: Autoscaler logs: "quotaExceeded: requested 80 gpus, quota 64" — scale attempts failing. Also seeing provisioner heartbeats delayed.

jessica: Customer impact: increased 504s for some users and high p99 for embeddings and chat endpoints. product_support, any inbound tickets?

product_support: FYI two customers reported timeouts ~10:15 PDT, one labeled P1 (real-time chat). They're seeing intermittent 504s and slow partial responses.

ops-bot: metrics snapshot: queue_depth=12432, running_gpus=128, desired_gpus=200, scale_failures=47, p95_latency=2.3s, p99_latency=12.7s

jessica: Immediate plan: 1) enable aggressive fallback routing (model downgrade to smaller variant) for non-SLA tenants; 2) temporarily throttle/ban noisy tenant(s); 3) enable prefix/KV cache bypass reduction; 4) attempt manual restart of provisioner leader to clear stuck requests. I will start 1 & 2 now.

tom: Applying tenant-level throttles: PATCH /admin/tenants/ad-campaign-proxy {rate_limit: 20rps} — applied.

maria: Rolling model downgrade: set default model for hosted-tier -> rdl-neo-1-small for non-paid. Command: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/configs/fallback -d '{"scope":"nonpaid","model":"rdl-neo-1-small"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN'``` — done.

jessica: After throttles + downgrade: ops-bot shows queue_depth=7601, p95=900ms, p99=4.1s. Partial relief. Still seeing scale failures due to cloud quota.

derek: Opened cloud support ticket referencing provisioner request ids and quota errors. Requesting urgent GPU quota increase. Ticket: CLOUD-9981.

mike: (oncall-night) I'll standby for handoff. Any long-running actions I should continue?

jessica: Handing to @mike in 30m if stable. Current mitigations: tenant throttle in place, fallback routing active, provisioner restart queued. We need infra to request quota increase and add guardrail to avoid sudden huge desired_gpus spikes.

ops-bot: provisioner restart job submitted: job_id=prov-restart-879. Note: restarting may cause short-term task churn; prepared rollback ready.

tom: Restarted provisioner leader. Observed backlog flush: blocked provision requests retried. Errors on restart: transient DB sessions hitting limit; increased DB connection pool for provisioner temporarily.

maria: Post-restart telemetry: queue_depth=4200, running_gpus=136, desired_gpus=140, scale_failures=5. p95=320ms, p99=1.2s. Looks stable and improving.

product_support: Notifying affected customers: sent status update to P1 and P2 — they acknowledged mitigation and will monitor.

derek: Root cause hypothesis: sudden high-volume low-SLA traffic from tenant(s) + autoscaler not handling large single-step increases because cloud quota prevented scale and led to queue spiral. Follow-ups: change autoscaler to incremental ramp and add quota-aware prechecks.

jessica: Agreed. Follow-up action items: - Autoscaler: quota precheck + incremental ramp logic (eng-runtime) - Runbook: add tenant noise detection + automatic throttle (sre) - Alerting: add quota-exceeded alert with paging (ops) - Cloud: pursue quota increase (infra)

mike: Acknowledged handoff — I will monitor for next 6h, keep throttles and fallback in place until quota resolved. If p99 > 3s again I'll page.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity downgraded to SEV2. Created follow-up ticket RW-INC-2026 with action items.

jessica: Marking this thread as monitored. Good work team — please add any logs to the RW-INC-2026 thread.

customer-success: Customers appreciate the quick response, asked for notice when quota increased and permanent mitigation rolled out.

jessica: Closing active paging for now. Will schedule a postmortem and attach timeline. :thumbsup:
